seatedToss.guidance: Tabili kɔrɔ sigi, ka sakɔ fitinin jɔ tarɛti kɔnɔ, mɔgɔ fila fila. Hakilisɛbɛn kɛ ɲɔgɔn ye kaga kan.
steps: Tarɛti ni hakilisɛbɛn bɔ, ka a da tabili kan ɲɔgɔn fɛ.
I sigi ka ɲɛ, mɔgɔ kelen fɛ kɛlɛ kelen. Kɛlɛ kelen-kelen fitinin jɔ, walima i ka tɛmɛn ni i fɛ tɛ.
Ni fitinin bɔra ring kɔnɔ, mɔgɔ min jɔra, o bɛ kolonu kɔnɔ sɛbɛn dɔ kɛ, ring min kɔnɔ, o kɔ.
Ni i bɛ se, i ka sɛbɛnw ɲɔgɔn ye ka ɲɛ ka sɛbɛnw ɲini. Mɔgɔ si tɛ ko hakilicɛ kɛ.
Ni mɔgɔ dɔ ye ka tɛmɛn, o waati ye ka sigi.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Sakɔ min kɔ ka tɛmɛ walima saniyɛ kɔ sakɔ kelen kɛ. Sigi, ka a jɛ mɔgɔ dɔ fɛ ka a ɲɛ. Fɛn dɔgɔw bɛ gɛlɛya kɛ ka nɛ tɛgɛ.
flags: Ni a bɛ dɔgɔ 3 ma, fɛn dɔgɔw ka gɛlɛ
Ka a to da kɔ ma
safety: Sakɔ min kɔ ka tɛmɛ, walima saniyɛ sakɔ kɔ. Ka a ɲɛ kɛ fɔlɔ, ka a ɲɛ ka i ka mɛn kɛ ka bɔ.
Fitinin, dɛgɛ walima fɛn wɛrɛw bɛ gɛlɛya kɛ ka nɛ tɛgɛ. Ka olu to denw ma ni mɔgɔ min bɛ fɛn da da kɔnɔ.
Ni fɛn bɛ da da kɔnɔ, i ka a ɲɛ kɛ jɔnjɔn, ka a ɲɛ ka sɛgɛn.
Sigi. Ka bɔlɔ kɛ tarɛti kan ka sɛgɛn ka tɛ mɔgɔ ɲɛ kan.

coloringWall.guidance: I ka dɛsɛgɛ ni waraka joona sugandi. Sɛbɛnni kogo, mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛ waraka kelen walima ka tɛmɛn kɔlɔr di. Waati si tɛ dɔn, sɛbɛn tɛ, marakɛ tɛ.
coloringWall.previewLabel: {picture|lower} bɛ waraka {n} kɔnɔ, {across} bɛ jɛ fɛ ani {down} bɛ dɔrɔn. Waraka kelen-kelen bɛ tɔgɔ kɔnɔ a kɔrɔ.
coloringWall.previewCaption: Dɛsɛgɛ min bɛ waraka sɛbɛnw ni tɔgɔw kɔnɔ.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Hɛrɛfɛw bɛ taa dɔrɔn, nimɔrɔw bɛ taa jɛ fɛ, o la A1 ye waraka ka kɛnɛ ni kan ye.
steps: Waraka bɛɛ sɛbɛnni. Waraka fɔlɔ ye nin kɔrɔ ni jɛ laɲini ye.
Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛ waraka kelen walima ka tɛmɛn ta, k'u kɔlɔr di.
Kɔlɔr ni sɛbɛn tɛ ka kɛ kelen ye. Waraka bɛɛ ye dɛsɛgɛ kelen ye.
Jɛ waraka tɔgɔw la, o kɔfɛ u kɔnɔ ni kɛmɛ tapɛ ta u kɔ fɛ.
Jɛ kɔnɔ yɔrɔ min na mɔgɔ bɛɛ bɛ se ka o ye.
coloringWall.mapLabel: Jɛ laɲini: sira {down}, sira kelen-kelen {across} waraka kɔnɔ, tɔgɔ A1 fɔ {last} kɔfɛ.
coloringWall.edgeNote: Kɛnɛ ka sɛgɛn bɛ waraka kelen-kelen dɔgɔ. Waraka ɲɛ ni u ka kɛnɛ kan, walima u ka kɛnɛ tɛ tɛ ni u ka sɔgɔ.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Dɛsɛgɛ: {picture}. Nin jɛ ye waraka {n} ye: {across} jɛ fɛ, {down} dɔrɔn.

findTogether.guidance: Kɛlɛ bɛ tɔɔ. I ka kɛlɛ kɔnɔ, karti fila kɔrɔ ka fila-fila sɔrɔ. Fila-fila sɔrɔ ni ɲɛ nɔgɔn.

conversationCards.groupSit: Sigi kɔrɔ ka kɔnɔ, mɔgɔ bɛɛ ka dɛsɛgɛ ye. Mɔgɔ min bɛ karti kɔnɔ, walima dɛsɛgɛ ka ɲɛ bɛ yɔrɔ min na, o bɛ kɛlɛ fɔlɔ kuma ka ɲɛ.
conversationCards.groupPass: O kɔfɛ, karti ka tɛmɛn mɔgɔ filanan ma. Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ kuma dɔ walima kuma dɔ dɛsɛgɛ kan, o kɔfɛ a tɛmɛn.

conversationCards.groupEnd: Kɔrɔ bɛ ban ni karti bɛ taa jamu kɔnɔ bɛɛ la, walima ni jamu ye hakɛ kɛ. Cɛ si tɛ sɔrɔ. Aw bɛ se ka ban wagati o wagati ni jamu fɛ.

Aw ka dumu-dumunin duman dɔ fɔ an ye.
Aw bɛ dutɛ walima kafe min cogo jumɛn na?
